findings.title: Arbitrary Origin Reflected with Credentials Allowed on /api/vulnerable/profile
findings.evidence: Origin: https://unauthorized-attacker.test reflected in Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://unauthorized-attacker.test with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true
reproduction_steps: Send GET to http://localhost:3000/api/vulnerable/profile with header 'Origin: https://unauthorized-attacker.test'
Verify response contains 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://unauthorized-attacker.test' and 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true'
findings.impact: High. Untrusted external web origins can read sensitive user data and bypass browser SOP.
findings.remediation: Replace dynamic origin reflection with a static allowlist of trusted origins.
